name: template-library-shareable
body: The `templates/` directory is a self-contained, relocatable unit: every reference stays inside the library root — paths are relative and resolved within the library, with no absolute paths, no `..` escapes and no references into `slides/` or the project `assets/` — it carries its identity and format version in `templates/library.yaml`, and it holds no machine- or project-specific state, so it can later be the root of (or be pulled from) its own git repository without layout changes. Within the library, a theme's `theme.css` — and every CSS it imports — may reach any servable file: its own theme directory, the resolved library's shared `media/` tree (via the reserved `media:` URL prefix) and another theme's files (via the reserved `theme:<name>/` prefix), both valid for `url()` and `@import` and both resolved inside the library root (theme-media-references). Every target lives inside the library and no reference escapes it, so the self-contained/relocatable property is preserved. (Forward compatibility with git-based sharing; git-based sharing itself is out of scope now.)
